focus: ChannelMessages::CreateOrganizationChannelMessage — verify it passes subject through correctly

tests_run.name: CreateOrganizationChannelMessage with subject in params
tests_run.detail: Subject 'QA Test Subject Line - Agent 13' was passed through context.params to channel.channel_messages.build(), persisted to DB, and verified on reload.

tests_run.name: CreateOrganizationChannelMessage without subject in params
tests_run.detail: When subject is omitted from params, channel_message.subject is nil as expected.

tests_run.name: Subject passthrough with various values
tests_run.detail: Tested 5 subtypes: normal subject, empty string, 255-char subject, special chars (& < >), and unicode. All persisted correctly without modification.

tests_run.name: No duplicate body check in CreateOrganizationChannelMessage
tests_run.detail: Unlike CreateChannelMessage (which has a duplicate body check), CreateOrganizationChannelMessage has no duplicate check. Two messages with the same body but different subjects were both created successfully.

tests_run.name: CustomChannelMessageValidator validates subject for unresolved placeholders
tests_run.detail: Subject with {{CandidateFirstName}} was correctly rejected by the validator. Body with unresolved placeholder was also rejected. Clean subject+body passed validation.

code_analysis.interactor_mechanism: CreateOrganizationChannelMessage passes context.params directly to channel.channel_messages.build(context.params). The interactor itself does not filter, transform, or drop any fields from params. Subject passthrough is purely a function of ActiveRecord mass assignment.
code_analysis.validation: validates :subject, custom_channel_message: true — checks for unresolved {{...}} placeholders. Subject is NOT required (nil is valid).
code_analysis.deprecation_warning: CustomChannelMessageValidator uses record.errors[attribute] << msg (deprecated in Rails 6.1+). Should use record.errors.add(attribute, msg). Not a bug for subject passthrough but worth noting.

summary: No bugs found. CreateOrganizationChannelMessage correctly passes subject through params to ActiveRecord build. The subject column exists on channel_messages, is validated for unresolved placeholders, and is nullable. All callers that pass subject do so correctly. The interactor is a thin pass-through — it does not modify, filter, or drop any fields from context.params.
